@name: Mariner
@slug: mariner
@source: mentalism_companion
@category: RMFRP Mentalism Companion
@default_cost: 43
@description:
 [Lifestyle] While a common sailor may find himself at sea thanks to the
 blandishments and occasional force of the press-gang, the Mariner has chosen
 a life on the ocean wave. Years of hard training in the skills of seamanship
 and the arts of navigation transform youthful midshipmen into competent
 sailing masters, ship's mates and naval officers, who with luck, ability,
 favour and perhaps hard cash, will one day command their own ship. Quote:
 When you live upon the sea, she is your everything. She is your mother; she
 is your foe. She will test you. She is your lover, and your nemesis. She is
 your goddess. Respect her and learn from her. Listen to her lessons, and
 remember them. Learning the ropes and ranks is another matter, and involves
 an entirely different kind of respect.... Time to Acquire: 144 months.
 Starting Money: normal.
